Based on the provided excerpts, here is the comparison of the gross profit margin percentages for Adobe Inc. (FY2024) and NVIDIA Corporation (FY2025):

---

### **1. Adobe Inc. (Fiscal Year 2024)**
* **Revenue:** $21,505 million
* **Gross Profit:** $19,147 million
* **Gross Profit Margin:** 
  $$\frac{\$19,147\text{ million}}{\$21,505\text{ million}} \approx 89.035\% \quad (\text{reported as } 89\%)$$

*(Source: Adobe Inc. Form 10-K, Item 8 - Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements, Note 2 - Revenue, chunk `b8fa3362-a910-51b7-aebe-a44fa81085a4`)*

---

### **2. NVIDIA Corporation (Fiscal Year 2025 - Year Ended Jan 26, 2025)**
* **Revenue:** $130,497 million
* **Gross Profit:** $97,858 million
* **Gross Profit Margin:**
  $$\frac{\$97,858\text{ million}}{\$130,497\text{ million}} \approx 74.989\% \quad (\text{reported as } 75.0\%)$$

*(Source: NVIDIA CORP Form 10-K, Item 7 - Results of Operations, chunk `93aeffcc-2941-55ff-b45d-98f673c12e6c`; Item 15 - Consolidated Statements of Income, chunk `c9862a91-8d43-5ada-9a5a-5ad310403d2f`)*

---

### **Comparison**
* **Higher Gross Profit Margin:** **Adobe Inc.** recorded the higher gross profit margin.
* **Percentage Point Difference:**
  * **Using reported percentages:**  
    $$89.0\% - 75.0\% = 14.0\text{ percentage points}$$
  * **Using exact calculated percentages:**  
    $$89.035\% - 74.989\% \approx 14.05\text{ percentage points}$$
